step.cmd: Before sending the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction to IPOC, determine if a Level 2 officer must adjudicate any outstanding issues:
In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if a decision has been rendered:
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “Input renewal w/c [XXXX], CT [XX].”

Remarks lines 2–4: Enter the appropriate information:
If the claimant’s reports’ information is available and coding is not required, type “M151 CR from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].”
If the claimant’s reports’ information is available and coding is required, type “M152 CR from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], earnings $[XXXX], NA [not available days], sickness [sick days], FWW [XX]” and other relevant information regarding the claimant’s reports input for each period (e.g. M152 CR from w/c 2000 to 2010, earnings $400, 2011, sickness 3).
If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].”
If an extension of the BP is required, type “Extend BP Type [X], Start week [XXXX], Number of weeks [X].”
If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
